# snipeit_supplier (Resource)

Manages a supplier in Snipe-IT.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the supplier. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Street address of the supplier.
- `address2` (String) Street address of the supplier, line 2.
- `city` (String) City of the supplier.
- `contact` (String) Contact person at the supplier.
- `country` (String) Country of the supplier (two-letter code recommended).
- `email` (String) Email address of the supplier.
- `fax` (String) Fax number of the supplier.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `phone` (String) Phone number of the supplier.
- `state` (String) State/province of the supplier.
- `url` (String) Website of the supplier.
- `zip` (String) Postal code of the supplier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the supplier.
